hook: About a quarter of CA1 neuron output synapses onto each other are silent because vesicles are not primed.
summary: Hippocampal CA1 pyramidal cells were thought to barely talk to each other. Two-photon glutamate imaging of single boutons, matched with electron microscopy, showed about 25% of boutons contacting CA1 cell spines release little or no glutamate. Drugs and extra calcium that boost vesicle priming revived them. Work was done in brain slices, so behavior in living animals is untested.
title: Incomplete synaptic vesicle priming functionally disconnects CA1 pyramidal cells.
